title: Exact configuration width
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. If $W_M(n,s)$ denotes the width obtained by the configuration encoding, then $W_M(n,s)=2n+4+|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1+3k(2s+1)$, where $|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1$ is the number of machine states plus one.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
